blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Meralco knows anything can still happen, even as it gained ground in the wild chase for the three remaining quarterfinal spots in Group B of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. The Bolts came away with a 120-115 win over the Blackwater Bossing on Tuesday to climb into fourth with a 4-5 record going into the final group stage match against the Phoenix Fuel Masters. “Magrarambulan pa yan [and] everybody plays everybody,” said Trillo. “But at this point, we need to control what’s in front of us, which is Phoenix.” They face the Fuel Masters on Friday at Ynares Center in […]...
